system.name: ByteRobust
system.one_liner: a large-scale GPU infrastructure management system that detects, diagnoses, and recovers from failures during LLM training

components.name: Pod 0 / Pod 1 / Pod N
components.role: per-job training pods, each running the data plane's monitoring and diagnostic modules

components.name: Training Processes
components.role: the LLM training job's processes running on the pod's GPUs

components.name: GPU
components.role: GPU used by the training job

components.name: Monitor
components.role: collects multifaceted data to detect outliers and triggers aggregation analysis

components.name: Diagnoser
components.role: runs domain-specific benchmarks and test suites after job suspension for in-depth diagnosis

components.name: CKPT Manager
components.role: performs asynchronous checkpointing with cross-parallel-group backups to CPU memory and local disk

components.name: On-demand Tracer
components.role: captures stack traces from training processes and uploads them to the Runtime Analyzer

components.name: Robust Agent
components.role: daemon running in each training pod, processing control signals from the Robust Controller

components.name: Runtime Analyzer
components.role: aggregates stack traces from training pods to isolate and (over-)evict suspected machines

components.name: Robust Controller
components.role: orchestrates automated failure mitigation, hot-update restarts, and requests warm standby machines

components.name: Warm Standby Pods
components.role: pre-validated standby machines the Robust Controller requests to resume a job

flows.what: control flow: coordination between the two control-plane modules
control flow: request for pre-validated standby machines

content.key_idea: shows ByteRobust's two-part architecture — an external control plane (Robust Controller + Runtime Analyzer) that detects/localizes/recovers from failures, and a data plane of per-pod Robust Agents (Monitor, Diagnoser, CKPT Manager, On-demand Tracer) that provide real-time observability and diagnostics — connected by explicit data-flow and control-flow arrows
content.reading_order: left (Data Plane with stacked Pod 0..N and their sub-modules) to right (Control Plane with Runtime Analyzer and Robust Controller, plus Warm Standby Pods), following the color-coded legend at the bottom

palette.used_for: Robust Agent and Runtime Analyzer boxes

style.stroke: black plus colored arrow strokes (orange/blue), ~0.24pt thin

encoding.color_means: orange arrows = data flow, blue arrows = control flow (explicit legend); pastel box colors differentiate data-plane pod components from control-plane components
encoding.line_style_means: solid orange lines denote data flow, solid blue lines denote control flow, per the figure's own legend
encoding.emphasis: the explicit data-flow/control-flow legend and the stacked Pod 0..N boxes emphasize per-pod replication and the separation of control from data paths
reusable_patterns: control-plane/data-plane split with an explicit color-coded flow-type legend

evidence: ByteRobust consists of two core components, control plane and data plane
The data plane resides within each training pod and integrates modules for monitoring, diagnosing
Robust Controller orchestrates an automated failure mitigation framework

summary: ByteRobust is a large-scale GPU infrastructure management system for ByteDance's LLM training that automatically detects, diagnoses, localizes, and recovers from training failures to maximize effective training time. Figure 4 shows its two-part architecture with an explicit data-flow/control-flow legend: the Data Plane (left) stacks per-job Pod 0..Pod N, each containing Training Processes (eight GPUs) alongside Monitor, Diagnoser, CKPT Manager, and On-Demand Tracer modules, all coordinated by a Robust Agent daemon; the Control Plane (right) contains the Runtime Analyzer, which aggregates stack traces (orange data-flow arrows) to isolate hung or degraded machines, and the Robust Controller, which exchanges control signals (blue arrows) with the Robust Agent and can pull in Warm Standby Pods to replace evicted machines. The color-coded arrow legend at the bottom makes the data-versus-control distinction explicit throughout the diagram.
summary_zh: 图4展示ByteRobust架构：数据面由多个Pod（含GPU训练进程及监控/诊断/检查点/追踪模块）经Robust Agent管理，控制面的运行时分析器与Robust控制器负责故障定位与恢复，图例区分数据流与控制流。
